stable.message: No stable release yet. Please use beta or dev.

beta.name: rasqberry-beta-2026-10-04
highlights: New A/B image: the SD card stays in the Pi for good. New releases install over the air into the other system, and the Pi falls back by itself if one doesn't work (64 GB+, 128 GB recommended)
Taskbar badge shows which system runs, and tells you when a new release is out, with what's new
New demos (beta): Workshop & Qiskit Server, Qiskit Tutorials on this Pi, Fun with Quantum website and family
Also new: Quantum Lab (QuBins), the Mermin-Peres game, My Quantum Programs, and a demo catalogue with traQmania and the SAP quantum demos
Learning paths (beta): guided tours through the demos, with tips on where to go next
Imager settings (Wi-Fi, SSH key, keyboard) work on both images; every demo is pinned to a tested version and stops the same way
